impl.summary: Full songs on both engines. MiniMax Music 3 runs on your GPU (oss-minimax-music-3, core nodes, int8 files pinned) and in the cloud on fal (minimax-music-3, 'MiniMax Music 3 · both engines', $0.002/s); YuE2 sings lyrics and covers an added song on your GPU only (oss-yue2; hosted on neither fal nor Replicate). The cloud gains Mureka 9 (song), Mureka 9 Instrumental, ElevenLabs Music v2.5 and Lyria 3.5, and Mureka 9.5 (id mureka-song kept) moved to its own v9.5 route with fal's current prices. Audio → Music has a lyrics editor (section-tag chips, character count, Instrumental, 'Write the lyrics' through the install's AI helper) and lengths up to 5:00; a new Audio → 'Extend & remix' mode and a song's result actions/next steps run Mureka's extend, remix and stems (cloud), by Mureka's own song id or after a $0.01 upload. Faceless/Explainer's music bed can be MiniMax Music 3 or ElevenLabs v2.5. All three graphs validated on the live CPU ComfyUI; full Vitest run: only the 6 known main failures plus one load timeout that passes alone.

findings.title: The stems zip unpacker's zip-bomb guard can be bypassed: it trusts the sizes the archive's directory declares
findings.detail: unzip() adds the central directory's declared uncompressed size to `total` (a crafted entry can declare 0), and each deflated entry may inflate up to the whole budget (inflateRawSync maxOutputLength = maxBytes, 512 MiB), not the budget that is left. Several directory entries can also point at the same local entry, so they overlap. The download in stemsFromZip is a plain fetch(zipUrl) with no byte cap and no timeout, read whole with arrayBuffer(), and the inflate runs synchronously on the server's event loop. Path traversal is not an issue, because names only become meta.stem and nothing is written to disk. The archive comes from Mureka through fal, so exploiting this needs a malicious or compromised provider answer. The path is also reached in an account's run on its own fal key (docs/public-signup.md 'Your keys'). The tests in tests/music3-open.test.ts only use archives with honest headers.
findings.verified: Copied unzip.ts into the scratchpad and fed it a crafted archive (one deflated local entry, N directory entries pointing at it, declared size 0). With maxBytes 60 MiB: 10 files, 500 MiB returned from a 51,562-byte zip. With the defaults: 20 files, 7.81 GiB unpacked (limit 0.5 GiB) from a 408,801-byte zip, 25.9 s blocking, RSS 8.29 GiB. 64 entries would reach about 32 GiB.
findings.fix: Count the bytes actually inflated and pass maxOutputLength = maxBytes - total. Refuse duplicate or overlapping local offsets, and entries whose inflated length differs from their declared size. Cap the download (Content-Length plus a streamed byte limit and AbortSignal.timeout). Add a test with a crafted archive.

findings.area: src/lib/output-actions.ts (Extend song / Remix / Stems), mureka-stems / mureka-remix routes, plan.ts
findings.title: Stems and Remix are offered on songs Mureka's endpoints refuse, with no check and no conversion
findings.detail: fal's schema for mureka/api/song/stem (fetched 11-02): audio_url is 'an MP3 or M4A song to separate, up to 10 MB'. Fuobe sends whatever file the song is. The result menu offers Stems on every music result, but fal's minimax/music-3 (the new 'both engines' model) answers with '44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo WAV', about 10.6 MB a minute, so a song at the default 2:00 is about 21 MB WAV. Songs added in Extend & remix are often WAV or FLAC. For mureka/v8/song/remix, fal's page says 'Source audio must be 10–350 seconds long. Vocal-only, accompaniment-only, and instrumental tracks are not supported'. Remix is still offered on Mureka 9 Instrumental, ElevenLabs and Sonilo beds, and songs up to 10 minutes, and a non-Mureka song is first sent through files/upload, billed $0.01, before the remix fails. The open graphs save MP3 V0, so their songs fit unless longer than about 5 minutes.
findings.verified: Scratch probe: planGeneration accepts mureka-stems with inputs.audio '/api/files/bed.wav' and builds {audio_url: 'https://x/bed.wav'}. mureka-remix plans for any source. Schema text is quoted from fal's openapi.json and model page. Not run against fal (no key).
findings.fix: Convert to MP3 (the fluent/ffmpeg path main already has) or refuse up front with a plain message about format, size and length. Hide Remix on instrumental results (Mureka Instrumental, a run whose lyrics are only [Instrumental]).

findings.area: src/components/studio/studio-page.tsx draftFromGeneration, composer.tsx songDraft, payload.ts, fal.ts submit
findings.title: Reusing an Extend or Remix run keeps the old Mureka song id, so a song swapped in afterwards is ignored
findings.detail: draftFromGeneration copies r.params as they are (only lyrics are taken out), so params.extra.songId comes back with the run. Draft.song is not restored, and songDraft only checks the attached file against Draft.song. If the person replaces the song in the reused draft, buildRequest still sends extra.songId. buildPayload then sets song_id, and the fal provider skips files/upload because payload.song_id is set. Mureka extends or remixes the original song, not the one shown. extend_at is also read from the new file's length, and the estimate leaves out the $0.01 upload. Nothing on the server ties songId to the attached file (POST /api/generations from MCP or Assist can pair any id with any audio).
findings.verified: Traced studio-page.tsx L170-213 (params = { ...r.params }), composer.tsx songDraft L240-247 and buildRequest L158-209 (params passed through), payload.ts L537-538, fal.ts L151-156. Not run in a browser.
findings.fix: Strip extra.songId in draftFromGeneration and restore it as Draft.song {id, url: r.inputs.audio}, so the existing check against the attached file applies.

findings.title: ACE-Step with the new 'optional' lyrics left empty sings the template's sample lyrics
findings.detail: This package puts the lyrics editor on ACE-Step, marked 'optional' and with an Instrumental chip, and removes the 'add lyrics on new lines' placeholder. With nothing written, no lyrics value is bound, so node 94 keeps the template's neo-soul words ('[Intro - Guitar Riff & Drums] mm… yeah… let it breathe… [Verse 1] Late night glow on your skin…') and the song sings them. MiniMax Music 3's graph defaults to [Instrumental]; ACE-Step's manifest defaults have no lyrics. The behaviour is already on the base, but this package's new editor now tells people the field is optional.
findings.verified:
Scratch probe: prepareWorkflow('music-ace-step-15', {prompt: 'lo-fi beat', extra: {}}) sends lyrics '[Intro - Guitar Riff & Drums]
mm…
yeah…
let it breathe…

[Verse 1]
Late night gl…'.
findings.fix: Give music-ace-step-15 a lyrics default of '[Instrumental]' in library.spec (as music-minimax-3 has), or send it from plan when a model that sings gets no words.

findings.title: Saved Mureka runs silently lose their chosen version; Mureka 7.6, O2 and 8 leave the cloud
findings.detail: mureka-song moved to mureka/v9.5/generate/song and drops a saved run's params.extra.model. A saved or reused 'mureka-9' run now runs Mureka 9.5 at $0.50 (fal's versioned route billed it $0.30, and mureka-9 now has its own id). 'mureka-7.6', 'mureka-o2' and 'mureka-8' now run 9.5 too, with no note. fal still serves those versions on mureka/api/generate/song ($0.03 / $0.045 with lyrics, $0.30 from a prompt; schema fetched 11-02), so the cloud loses hosted choices it had.
findings.verified: Scratch probe: plan + payload for mureka-song with extra.model 'mureka-9' and 'mureka-7.6' both give {prompt, duration: 180}, cost 0.5, notes [].
findings.fix: Send a saved 'mureka-9' to the mureka-9 id (replaced.ts-style mapping, or a plan note), and either keep a model on the versioned route for 7.6, O2 and 8 or note the change on Reuse.

findings.title: Lyria 3.5's lyrics are checked alone, but the API caps prompt and lyrics together at 5,000 characters
findings.detail: google/lyria-3.5 takes prompt maxLength 5000. lyricsProblem checks only the lyrics against 5,000, then promptWithLyrics appends them to the description, so a long description plus long lyrics is refused by fal after the run is queued.
findings.verified: Scratch probe: 4,647 characters of lyrics plus a 510-character description pass planGeneration and build a 5,157-character prompt.
findings.fix: Check prompt + 'Lyrics:' + lyrics against 5,000 in plan (or give the inPrompt max as room left after the prompt).

findings.area: lyrics-editor.tsx Instrumental chip, minimax-music-2-5 / mureka-song / mureka-9
findings.title: The Instrumental chip sends '[Instrumental]' as lyrics to APIs that don't document that tag
findings.detail: Every model with optional lyrics shows Instrumental, which sets the lyrics to '[Instrumental]', and plan sends them. fal-ai/minimax-music/v2.5 has an is_instrumental flag and lists its tags as [Intro] [Verse] [Pre Chorus] [Chorus] [Bridge] [Outro] [Interlude] [Hook] [Break]: no Instrumental, and 'Pre Chorus' without a hyphen while Fuobe writes [Pre-Chorus]. Mureka 9 and 9.5 song take lyrics to sing and have separate instrumental endpoints, and the run is priced as a song from lyrics. Lyria (promptWithLyrics) and MiniMax Music 3 handle it.
findings.verified: Traced plan.ts L493-503 (a model with options.lyrics keeps '[Instrumental]') and payload.ts L539-540. Schemas fetched from fal. Runtime behaviour unverified (no key).
findings.fix: Map instrumental to is_instrumental for MiniMax 2.5, and hide the chip (or route to Mureka 9 Instrumental) for Mureka songs.

findings.title: The Faceless music bed has no server fallback for a model switched off, and its hint is wrong on the cloud
findings.detail: The video model has withOfferedVideo, but musicModel has no server fallback. If a bed model is switched off in Settings → Models & licences after an episode picked it, the picker shows the default, but resolveModels still uses the stored id and the music step is refused at render (generations.ts requireOffered). The Music section's hint 'Longer films play the bed again, with a soft crossfade on your GPU.' also shows on the cloud engine, where musicPlan plays the bed whole again with no crossfade.
findings.verified: Traced faceless.ts L736-742 (video only), L879, and settings-form.tsx L250.
findings.fix: Pick the first offered of [musicModel, music, ...musicChoices] on the server as for video. Word the hint per engine.

findings.title: The lyrics trim fails when the helper's text has no line break before the limit
findings.detail: words.slice(0, words.lastIndexOf('\n', max)): when lastIndexOf returns -1, this keeps all but the last character, so over-long lyrics reach the editor and plan refuses them later. Only the owner reaches this route: accounts get 403 own-gpu-tool and guests 401.
findings.fix: Fall back to slice(0, max) when no line break is found.

review.verdict: Changes needed before merge. The catalog, prices, schemas, licence records, pins and graphs are sound, and the suite shows only main's 6 known failures. Fix first: the stems unpacker's zip-bomb guard (it trusts declared sizes; a 400 KB archive unpacked to 7.8 GiB) and its unbounded download; Stems and Remix offered on songs Mureka refuses (WAV or over 10 MB, instrumental, over 350 s); and Reuse of an Extend or Remix run sending the old Mureka song id after the song is swapped. Also worth fixing in this package: ACE-Step singing the template's sample lyrics when the new optional lyrics are left empty. The rest is low. Merge the moved base (6 conflicts, including fal.ts and types.ts) before the PR.
